## meetup

title: allthings/react

venue: Globex

event chat: https://discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD

topics: React, Artificial Intelligence, Software Development, Web Development, JavaScript

settings to set by hand:
- [ ] Attendee limit: 1 (Meetup's minimum), so everyone else lands on the waitlist and takes their seat on Luma.
- [ ] Location: pick "Globex" from Meetup's place search, not a bare street address.
- [ ] Event chat: Discord, https://discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD.
- [ ] Comments: off.
- [ ] Co-host: add Andre Landgraf.
- [ ] Cover: the Luma cover padded to 16:9 on black, so Meetup's crop keeps all of it (bun run promo:cover 2026-08-12-react-at-acme).
- [ ] Cross-post to Remix Bay Area (meetup.com/remix-bay-area): its Discord chat link comes prefilled, so add no second one, and turn its registration form off, which otherwise blocks publishing.
- [ ] After publishing: announce it to each group, React San Francisco Bay Area and Remix Bay Area.
